2026-11-03 primary XML supplement: REF Table 4 tensile mean 6.01 ± 1.15 MPa, pooled across orientations, unknown tensile ± type and count. Existing REF density stays unchanged and does not inherit tensile methods/statistics. Six older composite-property discrepancy notes now explicitly limit REF comparator wording to the corresponding record; all numerical/statistical fields unchanged. Abstract 15% improvement claim remains contradicted by Table 4 D5.33 versus REF6.01. Fresh XML inspected; university PDF retrieval failed, so the old PDF digest is not a new acquisition or visual-review claim.

records.scope_note: Source-qualified solid formulation B with 5 phr recycled milled carbon fiber (mCF/rCF), PERBUNAN 3445 F NBR and the fixed Table 3 additives. The distinct 5 phr fiber loading defines the formulation relative to the other solid recipes and the existing mCF=0 REF. Identity is the source-defined solid NBR/recycled-milled-carbon-fiber formulation, not a specimen, test direction, curing condition, supplier grade or foam state. PERBUNAN 3445 in Table 2 abbreviates the section 2.1 PERBUNAN 3445 F input, not a second material. Sul is ACTMIX S-80 product input as added; no conversion to elemental sulfur or to a fully specified chemical composition is made. The recycled fiber input is not assumed to be pure carbon, and no source-unstated final mass fractions or filler-purity correction are inferred. Table 3 loadings are retained in phr without normalization. Catalog-only source-qualified experimental reference, not a universal tensile strength, engineering allowable, automatic calculator input, application certification or independently validated performance improvement. Preserve the abstract/Table 4 contradiction; no reinforcement benefit or direction-independent material law is asserted. M100/M200 are finite-extension rubber measures, not Youngs modulus, and are outside this selected property.
